name: Fragment of Becoming
whisper: It remembers what you're meant to be.
text: Instantly claim one unclaimed milestone of your mission

name: Fragment of the Turning Season
whisper: It hums of things to come.
text: Look through the entire World deck and rearrange it; you may move the Finale up or down by up to 3 cards

name: Fragment of Exchange
text: Swap your entire pack with any rival's pack; companions stay put

name: Fragment of the Surge
text: For your next 3 turns, every 5 or 6 counts as two successes

name: Fragment of Deep Growth
text: Permanently gain +1 to any stat, ignoring the per-game growth limit

name: Fragment of the Rewilding
text: Clear every trap, haunt, hex, and seal in the game, then set 2 traps for free

name: Fragment of the Gardener-Kings
text: Choose any explore card from the deck or discards and play it this turn with +3 dice
